summary: Tradition-affinity / novel-cell guard across the tag review pipeline — prevent recurrence of the v2 false-friend contamination class
description:
Root cause of the qwen-3-4b-guru v2 regression was a new-tradition review push accepting Greco-philosophical concepts onto finnic/celtic/norse chunks with zero prior presence in that tradition (see rellm docs/qwen-3-4b-v2-regression-autopsy.md and data/quarantine/ for the ~2,600-tag cleanup this triggered, corrected before the v3 retrain). The cleanup was entirely reactive. Three guards were agreed during that investigation but never built:

1. `rellm lint` pre-export gate: flag any (concept, tradition) cell in the export with zero prior accepted tags before this push, so a contaminated batch can't reach a training export unnoticed.
2. guru-web apply-preview warning: surface the same novel-cell signal (concept established elsewhere, first appearance in this tradition) in the apply-preview UI so the human applying tags sees it before committing.
3. guru-review-tags skill mini-dossier rule: when a review pass hits a novel cell, pull a couple of comparison quotes from an established tradition automatically rather than relying on the reviewer to notice.

Detection heuristic (from the original quarantine ranking): concept established with n>=20 accepted tags pre-push, zero presence in the target tradition, tags now present post-push. See rellm data/quarantine/suspect-ranking.csv for the concrete cell list this surfaced last time.
